claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The total withdrawal is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura Maintenance and Enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Oura is a Rust-native Cardano event pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.
Oura supports multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and supports sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The proposer states Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors and is the most starred project in the TxPipe portfolio.
The proposer states Oura has been funded twice through Project Catalyst, in Fund 9 and Fund 13, for feature development.

The maintainer scope includes code maintenance, protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixes, documentation, community support, contribution review, ecosystem feedback enhancements, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposer states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The proposer states independent oversight and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect, technically capable third parties, and a treasury management smart contract framework with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses and authorization thresholds.

summary: The document describes a 540,750 ADA treasury withdrawal submitted by Intersect for TxPipe's Oura maintenance, with a 12-month maintainer scope, administrative fee, claimed Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based oversight, but it does not provide a complete budget analysis, feasibility assessment, risk analysis, alternatives analysis, or failure-mode analysis.
